text:
maria: quick kickoff 90 0 - we're rolling a focused pricing page experiment for the upcoming product launch. primary goals: fewer inbound billing questions, clearer tier names, and a compact cost calculator that nudges trials.
josh: solid. which FAQ items should we prune vs elevate? do we have a list from support?
maria: support flagged two recurring confusions: 'commitments vs pay-as-you-go' and 'burst/reserved capacity'. aim for 1-line answers + an inline glossary link. keep it scannable.
lee: proposed tier name pairs: Option 1 = "Essentials / Growth / Enterprise"; Option 2 = "Starter / Predictable / Mission". i'm leaning to Option 2 for explicitness.
sam: calc UX idea: big prominent monthly slider (0 -> commit level), plus a toggle: [Committed | Pay-as-you-go]. show estimated monthly and a microcopy line: "Includes batching savings". advanced panel collapsible.
nina: inbound routing rule: if calculator output (committed monthly estimate) >= 5000 USD then route to enterprise SDR queue; else marketing nurture. capture utm_source + campaign. also tag webinar registrants for a benchmark drip.
josh: for the webinar cohort we want a short "benchmark narrative" paragraph comparing our Dedicated config to competitor Y. do we have current numbers?
maria: yes0 - bench for 4k tokens shows ~35% lower per-unit cost on our Dedicated config vs Competitor Y with comparable median latency. craft a non-technical blurb: "Lower per-unit cost at production scale" and link to the deeper appendix.
lee: launch post headline draft: "Pricing built for real production: clearer tiers + instant cost estimates". bullets: faster onboarding, calculator, benchmark snapshot.
sam: FAQ draft: Q: "What does committing mean?" A: "Committed plans lock a monthly allocation at a lower unit price and give priority access; excess usage is billed standard PAYG rates." add tooltip for "priority access" linking to glossary.
maria: CTA microcopy A/B: "Estimate my cost" vs "See my price". run 50/50 split.
nina: analytics event: pricing_calc_result. properties: commitment_mode, estimated_monthly_usd, utm_campaign, tier_variant. enterprise routing checks estimated_monthly_usd >= 5000.
josh: timeline check: copy + mock by Tue EOD, engineering implements slider Wed, QA Thurs, webinar drip ready Fri. A/B test runs 2 weeks.
lee: marketing slide ask: include charts for cost per 1k tokens and median latency at 4k seq. highlight the 35% diff. note in appendix: "Tested on Dedicated v2, 4k token window."
sam: small UI note: when "Committed" is active show a compact example line: "Commit $X/mo = Y reserved throughput". reduces questions.
maria: localization: add EUR currency toggle and a short EU privacy blurb. nina, add to compliance checklist.
nina: done - flagged for privacy review and included utm requirements.
josh: last thing: launch-bot, schedule a #general post for day-of with the benchmark snapshot + pricing link.
launch-bot: scheduled post set for 2024-09-12 10:00 UTC.
maria: great. next sync tomorrow 11am PT to review mocks. thanks all :raised_hands:
